claims.claim: Changes are limited to the authorized Shopee extractor and focused test file, preserving browser lifecycle, public contracts, extraction script, and TASK-156 lineage without live certification.

Extraction performs one acquisition and navigation, then samples the same page up to ten times with 0.5-second delays; trusted media or blocking terminates immediately, while invalid payloads, evaluation errors, and exhaustion fail closed.
Readiness and final ProductSourcePack construction share one trusted-media interpretation path preserving identity, provenance, precedence, ordering, and deduplication semantics.

Focused deterministic tests cover delayed hydration, immediate readiness and blocking, bounded exhaustion, exact acquisition/navigation counts, argument forwarding, invalid payloads, evaluation failures, and zero real sleep/network.
The final implementation is committed with exactly the two permitted changed files and no executor-unresolved items; canonical verification remains Runtime-owned.
